bootstrap.interpretation: Cluster resampling quantifies sensitivity to the sampled base-geometry design space. It is not a probability model for material properties, plant operation, manufacturing variability, or experimental uncertainty. Material pairs, topologies, and service requirements remain paired within each resampled base geometry. Integer-boundary perturbations are deterministic adversarial numerical stresses, not confidence intervals.
